died.name: Louis Slotin
died.cause: The 35-year-old Canadian physicist and Manhattan Project scientist died as the result of an accident while performing an experiment called "tickling the dragon's tail". Slotin used a screwdriver to separate two half sphere-shaped neutron deflectors enclosing a plutonium core which came to be known as the "demon core" to observe how much he can deflect the neutron without the core going over its critical mass. His screwdriver slipped, causing the top deflector to fully encase the core, resulting into a criticality accident that exposed him to a fatal dose of radiation. Slotin died 9 days later; the other people in the room observing the experiment survived.
